messages:
ashok: Heads up — after rolling auth-v2 to 10% canary, we're seeing a ~3x reconnect rate on SSE streams for customers in eu-west. trace ids in logs show token-reject then resume attempts. :frowning_face:

deploy-bot: deploy completed: auth-service auth-v2 canary -> 10% (sha: abc123) :rocket:

maria: logs show repeated lines: 'sse_disconnect:45 auth_error invalid_token' then client retries with Resume header, got 401 on resume

kev: do we rotate resume token format? auth-v2 changed token prefix from R_ -> RV_ last week

ashok: yeah, auth-service now requires new resume token signature. We didn't add backward compat for resume endpoints

sre-triage: paging metrics: p99 reconnects increased from 0.3% -> 0.9% in eu-west between 02:10-02:30. correlation with auth-v2 canary flag.

lisa: billing note: when client reconnects and resumes we sometimes emit two billing events for the same request id — possible dedupe key mismatch

consoleux: UX issue: Console shows generic 'Disconnected' and no error code. Customers can't triage, they file tickets. Would like a quick improvement to surface reason strings. :eyes:

ben: quick proposal: (1) add resume-token-version header to telemetry, (2) accept old token formats for resume server-side for a short grace period, (3) make resume idempotency tolerant for 60s window. Security review required.

ashok: mitigation: pausing canary on auth-v2 now.

deploy-bot: deploy paused: auth-v2 canary -> 0%

maria: minimal repro curl: 
```
curl -v -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' -H 'Authorization: Bearer R_old_token_123' "https://api.redwood.com/v1/stream"
```
Next response: server returns 401 then client attempts Resume: header and gets 401 on resume.

ben: server-side change sketch:
```
# naive
if resume_token.version != expected:
  return 401
# alternative
if signature_supported(resume_token):
  map_to_current_format(resume_token)
  accept_resume()
```
Note: mapping needs crypto review.

kev: routing note: sticky routing at gateway is cookie-based. When client reconnects through LB, resume request often lands on a different replica so KV cache misses and resume fails. We need header-based affinity for resume-token or resume-id.

ashok: agree — current gateway doesn't check resume headers for affinity. That's likely amplifying the issue.

sre-triage: telemetry fields to add asap: "resume_token_version", "sticky_backend_id", "auth_canary_tag", "sse_disconnect_reason". We should add these to traces and to streaming metrics so we can slice by token-version.

consoleux: Console change: show disconnect reason tooltip (401 invalid_resume, 400 malformed, 429 quota, etc.), and surface recommended next steps (update SDK, retry strategy). That will cut support load.

maria: I can open a small PR to log backend_id and parsed resume_token_version into existing sse disconnect logs (low risk).

lisa: billing fix: produce a dedupe key: request_id || '::' || resume_token_version. Audit pipeline for cases where resume_token_version absent -> treat as v0.

ashok: action items:
- maria: PR to add backend_id + resume_token_version to sse logs (today)
- ben: draft server-side acceptor fallback and security checklist (tomorrow)
- kev: spike header-based affinity at gateway (2d)
- consoleux: mockup to expose disconnect reason + suggested actions (EOW)
- lisa: audit billing dedupe keys (start tomorrow)

ashok: I'll follow up once the canary is fully rolled back. Thanks all :thumbsup:
